name: 33304 · Ft Lauderdale, FL
findings: ZIP 33304 (Ft Lauderdale) has 122 nonprofit organizations. 52 of them (43%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 45 organizations.
Arts and cultural organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (21% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 33304 (Ft Lauderdale) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 33304 (Ft Lauderdale) list volunteering in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 60% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 35 organizations here; 56% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
